comments.author: vibrantrida
comments.body_html:
DisableScavMode egboggied removes the Scav button in faction select screen, and has the optional feature of disable the Insurance screen (which doesn’t work)

My mod skips the faction selection menu altogether so when you press Escape From Tarkov you are immediately presented with the Map selection menu as a PMC.
